{"subject":"Congrats on Pulley's Series B","body":"Hi Michael,

Congrats on Pulley's $41M Series B four days ago. Rounds like this usually bring a board forecast request, and I saw Pulley has Enterprise Account Executive and Enterprise SDR Manager roles open, so new sellers will need a pipeline process in place.

Quillpath reads your CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) every night, flags stalled deals, and gives each rep a short list of next actions per deal. It also writes a weekly pipeline and forecast summary you can forward to the board. Setup takes about 15 minutes, with nothing to migrate.

Would you like to try the free 14-day pilot on your real pipeline?","missing":["Which CRM Pulley uses (HubSpot or Salesforce is not confirmed in the evidence)","Who owns the open sales roles or the board forecast at Pulley"]}
